note: Both sets cover the same lighting-levels table and the Title 24 text, and both repeat nearly every table fact two or three times. Set A binds the lamp counts and levels with consistent attributes and states the vacancy-sensor requirement in full (bypass dimming to completely disconnect the fixture), whereas Set B calls the bulbs a 'power source' and reduces the vacancy requirement to a bare 'must be able to bypass', losing the engineering point. Set A's only real error is the garbled value '40 W W' with the half-power qualifier pushed into conditions. Both sets omit the bulb-efficacy comparison (40W incandescent = 9W CFL = 7W LED).
remarks: Both extractions duplicate every lighting-levels table row (level, lamp count, and source each appear 2-3 times, sometimes with and without the activity condition), which inflates both sets. The table header reads 'HIGH CONSTRAT' in the image; both sets' quote variants ('CONSTRAT'/'CONRAST'/'CONSTRAC[T]') are approximations of that typo. Neither set captures the 40W incandescent / 9W CFL / 7W LED efficacy example or the dimmer-switch behavior, which are substantive facts on the page.
